extract_coco_keypoints: extract COCO dataset keypoints and bounding boxes from person_keypoints_train2014.json annotations into an npz file
export_pose3d_to_spin: export 3D pose estimation results from a pickle file to SPIN-compatible npz format with SMPL parameters
convert_coco_joints_to_spin24: convert COCO 17-joint keypoints to SPIN 24-joint format using the defined joints index mapping
compute_bbox_center_scale: compute bounding box center coordinates and scale factor from annotation bbox values for pose normalization
filter_valid_pose_samples: filter pose samples by minimum valid joint count and required limb validity before exporting to npz
